fields.name: Koaxian Chorus (Recharge 5–6)
fields.desc: Brekekekek, koax koax! The frogoblin sings her maddening chant. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet that can hear the frogoblin must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during its next turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

fields.name: Multiattack
fields.desc: The frogoblin makes two club attacks or one club and one tongue attack.

fields.name: Primordial Croak (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
fields.desc: The frogoblin croaks an ode to her people’s primordial past, invigorating other nearby frogoblins. She can target up to three frogoblins within 30 ft. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the next minute.

The frogoblin can have no more than one humanoid or beast charmed at a time. Each time the frogoblin or its allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

fields.desc: The trapezohedrone grinds two of its shields together, projecting a metallic screech that affects creatures in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d10+1) thunder damage and becomes shaken: the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save. Creatures that are immune to the stunned condition are not affected by this ability.

fields.desc: The trapezohedrone makes four glaive attacks.

fields.desc: The snail hides in its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to its AC until it emerges, which it can do as a bonus action on its turn. While hiding in its shell, the snail is restrained and cannot move.

fields.name: Multiattack
fields.desc: The snail makes two armed tentacle attacks.

fields.name: Scintillating Colors (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
fields.desc: The snail’s shell shines like a Robe of Scintillating Colors, displaying a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of the snail’s next turn. The snail’s shell sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius during this time, and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Any creatures within 30 feet of the snail when it uses this action must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned until the end of the snail’s next turn. Creatures also have disadvantage on attack rolls against the snail until the effect ends if they can see its shell.

fields.desc: If the wodyanoi is immersed in water, it may create a swirling vortex of water 10 feet wide and up to 30 feet long projecting out from itself in the direction of its choice. Each creature caught in the area of the gyre must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and is pushed to the end of the gyre furthest from the wodyanoi. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is not pushed.
